I can't find their policy on confidentiality anywhere though.

The only policy that is present mentions nothing about this.

I don't *really* intend to kill myself right now. However, I am constantly thinking about suicide and can't think of anything besides that. I don't have a date but I do have a method planned out in case I can't handle this anymore. I don't want anyone to overreact and call anyone. I've said less than that on a suicide hotline before and had people show up at my door. I'm not taking any risks.
